description: A mobile app for logging, rating and reviewing the video games you finish. Like Letterboxd, but for games.
page_title: Replay - Letterboxd for the games you finish
page_text: Replay. Keep the games you finished, and what you thought of them. Log a game when the credits roll, rate it, write two lines. Follow friends and see what they finished. Get a year-in-review at the end. Free on iOS, Android coming soon. Join the TestFlight.
